_changelog: v3: rewrote all rendered sections with cross-vertical referral intel from war-room trade research. Every trade knows 5+ adjacent-trade owners — the prompts now mine that network instead of asking generically. Schema unchanged — renders in existing cockpit.

intro.default: Hey {first_name}, before we wrap — quick ask, and it's fine either way. You've seen what we've done: {quick_win}. Here's the thing about my business — I don't run ads for myself, I grow off referrals from clients who are winning. So let me ask you straight: who's one contractor you know — doesn't have to be a {trade_lower}, could be any trade — who's great at the work but invisible online?
intro.training_note: Only run with visibly happy clients — results showing, relationship warm, zero open issues. If {quick_win} is stale, manually name the freshest specific number before asking: 'you went from 14 reviews to 31 and you're top 3 in {city}' gets referrals. 'Things are going well' does not. The cross-trade framing matters: asking a roofer for another roofer makes him name a competitor. Asking for ANY trade unlocks his whole network — his plumber, his electrician, the GC he subs for.

specificity_prompts: Who do you refer YOUR customers to when they ask for a trade you don't do — a plumber, an electrician, a concrete guy? Those guys already trust your name.
Any GC you sub work for — or who subs for you? They live and die on the same Google problem you had.
Anyone at your supplier's counter or in your trade association who's always saying business is slow?
Who's the best contractor you personally know that nobody can find online? The guy whose work is great but his phone isn't ringing.
Anyone you've seen advertising around {city} and thought — those guys are wasting their money?
Think about the last job site where three trades were working at once. Which of those crews could use what you just got?
warm_intro_script: If someone comes to mind — would you send a two-line text from your phone? Something like: 'Hey [name], been working with {rep_name} at Urban Niche — they do marketing for contractors only and they actually deliver. Worth 10 minutes.' A text from you is worth fifty cold calls from me. I'll take it from there and I won't make you look bad — that's a promise I can afford to make because it's my name on it too.
reciprocity_offer: And here's my end of it: whoever you send, I'll run a full free audit on their business and send the results to both of you — even if they never spend a dollar with me, they walk away knowing exactly what's broken. And I take care of the people who send me work. Ask around, that part gets remembered.
close: So — who came to mind first while I was talking? ... Perfect. When are you likely to see or talk to them next? I'll check back in a couple days to see how it landed. Easiest version: just forward them my number, {rep_phone}, and tell them to mention your name. That's it — and {first_name}, seriously, thank you. This is how I build.
